dct_title_s: Sumatra, North East Coast. : Diamond Point to Pulo Berhala
dct_description_sm: From the Netherlands Government charts to 1919 with additions from surveys by Comr. C.Y. Ward. I.N. 1858 & Lieut. H. Jackson, I.N. 1860.
Depths shown by soundings; relief by hachures and spot heights.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Tidal Information, Table for Conversion, navigational and abbreviation notes.
Inset chart: Deli River, Natural Scale 1:100,000 / From a survey by the Officers of the Netherlands Government Ship "Tydeman," 1919.
Numbered 1353 at bottom right, 107.39 at upper right.
